# flow

```go
import "github.com/lucasavila00/immutago/internal/borrow/flow"
```

Package flow contains the graph engines used by the borrow checker. The liveness, region propagation, and ranked dataflow algorithms are adapted from rustc commit 80196be0e787008b6fb14d2990aba92083cd68e1. See third\_party/rustc for source attribution and the MIT license.

## type Graph

Graph records normalized operation points. Point zero is the entry. Pred and Succ must describe the same directed edges.

```go
type Graph struct {
    Succ [][]int
    Pred [][]int
}
```

### func NewGraph

```go
func NewGraph(successors [][]int) Graph
```

NewGraph constructs predecessor edges and copies the supplied successor lists.

### func \(Graph\) ReversePostorder

```go
func (g Graph) ReversePostorder() []int
```

ReversePostorder returns reachable points in forward dataflow order.

## type Set

Set stores integer identities. Present entries always have value true.

```go
type Set map[int]bool
```

### func BackwardLive

```go
func BackwardLive(graph Graph, uses, definitions Set) Set
```

BackwardLive traces each use backwards to its reaching definitions, as rustc's compute\_use\_live\_points\_for does. Uses are included; definitions are excluded. The Go lowering separates use and definition points to preserve evaluation order.

### func Forward

```go
func Forward(graph Graph, gen, kill []Set) (inputs, outputs []Set)
```

Forward solves a union gen/kill analysis using rustc's minimum\-rank dirty worklist. Inputs are states before the point's kills; outputs are states after kills and generation. Callers must check accesses before applying assignment kills. Unreachable points remain empty.

### func NewSet

```go
func NewSet(values ...int) Set
```

NewSet returns a set containing values.

### func OutOfScope

```go
func OutOfScope(graph Graph, issuance int, region Set) Set
```

OutOfScope finds the first points outside a region on paths from issuance. It translates OutOfScopePrecomputer's walk over normalized operation points. A live issuance point must be included in region by the caller.

### func SolveRegions

```go
func SolveRegions(seeds []Set, outlives [][2]int) []Set
```

SolveRegions propagates liveness through outlives constraints after collapsing cycles. An edge \[sup, sub\] requires sup to contain every point in sub. Input sets are not changed. SCC values are solved in dependency order, matching rustc's region propagation.

### func \(Set\) Add

```go
func (s Set) Add(value int) bool
```

Add inserts value and reports whether the set changed.

### func \(Set\) Clone

```go
func (s Set) Clone() Set
```

Clone returns an independent set, including for a nil input.

### func \(Set\) Union

```go
func (s Set) Union(other Set) bool
```

Union inserts all members of other and reports whether the set changed.

### func \(Set\) Without

```go
func (s Set) Without(removed Set) Set
```

Without returns a copy with every member of removed excluded.
